summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new 'Görevler' (Tasks) feature. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests pass — GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/tasks all work, auth guards work (401 without Bearer), invalid status returns 400, patch on unknown id returns 404, past due_date accepted (status stays 'pending'; overdue is a frontend-only visual computation as documented). Frontend: TasksPanel renders as the 2nd of 4 tabs, task CRUD works end-to-end, checkbox toggles to done with strikethrough + emerald styling, right-click AND 3-dot menu both open the context menu with the correct action set for the current status (ctx-paused hidden when already paused, ctx-pending shown, etc.), ctx-paused paints the card yellow with 'BEKLEMEDE' badge, past due_date produces a red 'SÜRESİ GEÇTİ' card, and sort order is overdue → pending → paused → done. One minor testability issue: the stat-box data-testids are built with `label.toLowerCase()` on Turkish upper-case 'İ', which yields Unicode 'i̇' (U+0069 + U+0307 combining dot above). Actual testids in DOM are 'task-stat-akti̇f', 'task-stat-geçti̇', 'task-stat-bekli̇yor', 'task-stat-bi̇tti̇' — the review request assumes plain ASCII 'aktif/geçti/bekliyor/bitti'.

minor.issue: Deleting a non-existent id returns 200 with {deleted:0} rather than 404. Consistent with /api/notes and /api/reminders, so it's a codebase-wide convention rather than a Tasks-specific bug — noting for awareness.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testids for the 4 stat boxes are built via `label.toLowerCase()` on Turkish labels ('AKTİF','GEÇTİ','BEKLİYOR','BİTTİ'). Because JS non-locale toLowerCase turns 'İ' into 'i' + combining-dot (U+0307), the actual testids are `task-stat-akti̇f`, `task-stat-geçti̇`, `task-stat-bekli̇yor`, `task-stat-bi̇tti̇` — NOT the clean 'task-stat-aktif' etc. that a reader of the review request would expect. This makes them brittle for e2e tests.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In /app/frontend/src/components/TasksPanel.jsx lines ~357-361, replace `data-testid={`task-stat-${s.label.toLowerCase()}`}` with a hard-coded ASCII key on each stat item (e.g. 'pending'/'overdue'/'paused'/'done') so the testids are stable ASCII strings matching the review request. Purely testability; no user-visible impact.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_task builds `update = {k: v for k, v in req.model_dump(exclude_unset=True).items() if v is not None or k == 'due_date'}` — this allows explicitly clearing due_date via null, which is correct, but title/description cannot be cleared to empty string once set (empty string is falsy after Pydantic default? actually '' passes the `v is not None` check, so empty string IS accepted for title/description — that means you could set title='' via PATCH. Consider validating min_length on TaskUpdate.title.

TasksPanel.jsx isOverdue check is inconsistent with statusStyle: statusStyle uses `task.status === 'done' || task.status === 'paused'` to short-circuit, and isOverdue mirrors that. That's fine, but the initial 'pending' branch in statusStyle only differentiates hover styling — a task whose status is 'pending' and NOT overdue looks identical to a task with an unknown status. Consider explicit branch for unknown status to avoid silent visual bugs.

TasksPanel.jsx keydown Escape listener inside ContextMenu useEffect is registered but never removed — small memory leak accumulating over each open/close of the menu. Fix: return a cleanup that also removes the keydown handler.
ContextMenu positioning: `Math.min(x, window.innerWidth - 200)` uses hard-coded 200 for width; the menu min-width is 180 so it works, but if the menu ever grows this could clip. Minor.
The stat-box testid Turkish-lowercase bug (see ui_bugs) is a general reminder that any i18n text used in identifiers should be locale-independent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for functional flows (add / check / paused / pending / overdue / sort / delete / right-click / 3-dot menu). 1 minor testability nit on stat testids.

seed_data_creation: Test tasks are created and cleaned up within each test. No leftover TEST_ tasks in DB after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tasks feature is fully working end-to-end. If main agent addresses the stat-testid ASCII issue, a quick playwright query for 'task-stat-aktif' presence is enough to re-verify. Existing tasks in DB from user-side seeding (Bineği al / Helltide / Zorluk) are preserved; only TEST_UI prefixed tasks are created/deleted by the test scripts. Regression: /app/backend/tests/test_tasks.py can be re-run with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest tests/test_tasks.py`.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing feature. The stat-testid nit is caused by JavaScript's default toLowerCase() using a Unicode-conformant transformation on 'İ' (LATIN CAPITAL LETTER I WITH DOT ABOVE, U+0130) → 'i' + combining dot above (U+0307). Locale-aware `.toLocaleLowerCase('tr-TR')` would give 'i' — but the cleanest fix is to just hard-code ASCII keys on the stat objects instead of deriving them from the display label.
